title: Interest in one's own hands is on the four-month CDC list
summary: Most babies look at their hands with interest by four months, the CDC says.
body: By four months, CDC says most babies study their own hands. Grasping is a different skill and is not this item. The bar is three quarters of children on a United States checklist, and CDC says that checklist cannot stand in for a formal developmental screen.

sources.title: Milestones by 4 Months
sources.author: CDC
sources.note: Supports 'Looks at her hands with interest' by four months for most children (75% or more).
